content_sections.heading: About ACTREC
content_sections.text: ACTREC, the Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer, is part of Tata Memorial Centre. It is located at Sector-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. According to its letterhead, it is a Grant-In-Aid Institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Scientific Officer (Bioinformatics) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Ph.D. in Bioinformatics or Computational Biology or Related Fields. OR M.Sc. / M. Tech in Bioinformatics or Computational Biology or Related Fields. These candidates are also eligible, but at a lower grade. Proven proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, is required. Proficiency with (human) genome sequencing. One year of experience in next generation sequencing based data analytics (printed with the Ph.D. qualification). Experience in Cancer Bioinformatics. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview. TMC - ACTREC reserves the right to hold a written test to screen candidates before the interview if it feels this is necessary.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract. It is initially for one year and can be extended according to the requirement of the Centre. The work is in the Department of Hematopathology and Cytogenetics at ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ACTREC Scientific Officer (Bioinformatics) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the qualification, experience and age requirements as on 29 October 2026. Bring the documents listed below. Report to the venue on 3 November 2026 between 10.00 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. Candidates are seen only during this reporting time. Take the written screening test if ACTREC holds one, and then attend the interview. Paymaster Shodhika, Recruitment Cell, Room No. PS-330, Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC), Sector-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410 210. faq.question: Q1. When and where is the ACTREC Scientific Officer walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 3 November 2026 (Tuesday) at Paymaster Shodhika, Recruitment Cell, Room No. PS-330, ACTREC, Sector-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410 210.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Report between 10.00 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. Candidates are accepted only within this time.

faq.question: Q3. Can candidates with an M.Sc. or M. Tech apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with an M.Sc. / M. Tech in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a related field are eligible at a lower grade, on a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,100 a month.

faq.question: Q4. How much does a Ph.D. holder earn in this post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. holder gets a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,700 a month.

faq.question: Q5. Which programming skill is required?
faq.answer: Proven proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, is required. Proficiency with (human) genome sequencing is also listed under experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit, and on which date is it counted?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 40 years. Age and experience are counted as on 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: It is initially for one year and can be extended according to the requirement of the Centre.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Possibly. TMC - ACTREC may hold a written test to screen candidates before the interview if it feels this is necessary.

faq.question: Q9. Is travelling allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. No travelling allowance is paid for attending the interview.
